Sam Blake: Quick triage — RiverGate wants a POC to swap vendor -> Redwood. CTO blockers: API parity, demo surge pricing, security pack. Can we triage?
Ivy Tran: I'll do parity. Do they rely on streaming + candidate lists?
Sam Blake: Yes streaming + candidates for rerank.
Noah Brooks: Parity gotchas: event names (partial/done), usage fields split, stable IDs. We'll implement a light proxy to translate shapes.
Maya Chen: Security asks: SOC2 date, BYOK/KMS options, SAML, subprocessor list. I'll draft answers.
sec-bot: [auto] Questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood-internal/sec/rivergate-poc
Ivy Tran: Plan: 10 canonical prompts, 2 rerank flows, side-by-side. ETA EOD+3.
Noah Brooks: We'll preserve candidate IDs via deterministic hash so rerank API keeps working.
Maya Chen: Procurement: "If traffic spikes 1.8x, will we throttle or bill?"
Sam Blake: Offer trial credits + temporary burst cap; finance to confirm overage.
Sam Blake: Action items: Ivy parity tests (EOD+3), Noah id-mapping (EOD+3), Maya security draft (EOD+2), Sam confirm demo time (today). Kickoff 11am PT tomorrow. Post short updates here only. :thumbsup:
